newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-CHILAVERT TO MISS PARAGUAY WORLD CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILAVERT TO MISS PARAGUAY WORLD CUP MATCH.

text.p: Flamboyant goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert will miss Paraguay's next World Cup qualifying match after pulling a hamstring in the South American Supercup final on Wednesday night.
Chilavert suffered the injury playing for his Argentine club Velez Sarsfield against Brazil's Cruzeiro.

He said he would not be able to play in the game away to Bolivia on December 15. "The main thing now is for me to recover as quickly as possible. There is still a long way to go before the end of the qualifiers," he said.

The extrovert keeper, who habitually scores from free kicks and penalties, has been instrumental in helping his country, who are not ranked as one of the continent's soccer powers, into second place in the nine-team table.
Their best result was a 1-1 draw away to Argentina -- when Chilavert scored the Paraguayan goal from a free kick.

On Wednesday, Velez won 2-0 to take the final 3-0 on aggregate, with Chilavert missing a penalty near the end. If he had converted it, he would have finished as joint top-scorer in the competition, having already scored three goals.
